title: Seasonal itineraries and booking desk attribution
not_questions: We will not license Adobe Journey Optimizer.
Use our published sailing calendar when quoting travel dates.

questions.text: Describe how AEM Sites would publish one island itinerary in two currencies with a locally approved price note.
Explain how you would move the seasonal archive from Drupal to AEM Sites while preserving links on brochures already in hotels.
Show how AEM Sites would distinguish a supplier changing a ferry schedule from a travel editor cancelling an excursion.
Provide an AEM Sites exercise for reversing a price correction after a tour has been sold to its final passenger.
Explain how Customer Journey Analytics would distinguish a party reservation from the individual places sold on the same itinerary.
Describe how booking adjustments held in Snowflake would enter Customer Journey Analytics after a refund issued at the pier.
Show how Customer Journey Analytics would attribute an inquiry made online to a completed booking at a member hotel's desk.
Provide a Customer Journey Analytics report the board can use to compare confirmed and cancelled places by departure week.
Name the supplier's account lead and confirm who covers that role during our summer selling season.
Provide two client references for your firm's delivery of digital projects with seasonal booking peaks.
Quote your firm's daily rate for supporting a cooperative member outside the pilot group.
Explain your company's invoicing process when a member hotel requests work outside the board's approved budget.
